title: Payoneer pricing - $29.95 annual fee (often waived) plus 0.5%-3.99% per transaction
clean_text: Payoneer charges no monthly fee but applies a $29.95 annual account fee, automatically waived for accounts receiving $2,000+ USD (or equivalent) over a 12-month period. Card payments from clients cost up to 3.99% + $0.49; marketplace payments (Upwork, Fiverr, etc.) incur a 1% receiving fee; Payoneer-to-Payoneer transfers are generally free; currency conversion costs 0.5%-3.5%; bank withdrawals cost $1.50 flat; and ACH transfers cost 1%. Payoneer states the exact applicable fee is shown before a payment is confirmed.

meta.pricing_model: usage-based, per-transaction plus annual account fee
meta.pricing_unit: percent_per_transaction (varies by type, plus flat fees)
